title: A Ground Vehicle for a Day: The Checklist, the Mission, the Field, the Modes, the Unsticking and the Log Reader, on One Scripted Day, With and Without Them

artifact.note: a scripted day of a ground vehicle on one road: the checklist before leaving, a mission of three sites and home, a person who steps in front of it (the protective field), a snag (the unsticking ladder), a loss of GNSS and a short loss of the scanner (the modes), sand on the way (the energy), a release offered in the middle of a job and again at the dock (the vehicle's release check), and a log read at the end by the log doctor; run once with all of these layers and once without, and the day written up
